first_3_seconds: Rolling shot of a red lifted late-model Super Duty dually on the highway, edited so it sits on tiny stock-size wheels under the big lift; text sits above it the whole time; rap track playing
spoken_or_text_hook: Text: "California Trucks When The Tire Ban Kicks In"
why_it_went_viral: 88x the account median but only 0.9% shares: a news-peg joke about a rule people were already angry about, and the wrong-looking truck reads in one glance, so it pulled reach and comment arguments more than sends. The politics did the distribution, not the truck.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Lifted truck owners to the buddy on 38s; out-of-state guys to their California friend as a jab
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: One clip of your own truck plus one line of text tying it to a truck rule or price everyone is already arguing about this week.

why_it_went_viral: avoid: the laugh rides on a reaction clip of a real person who appears to have a disability, his face is the punchline. The share engine underneath (5.54% shares, 48x median) is the fuel price pain plus the red diesel wink, which is worth noting on its own.

why_it_went_viral: avoid: same reaction clip as bensdiesels-02, a real person who appears to have a disability used as the joke face. Proof the fuel price plus red diesel premise repeats (3.67% shares, 37x median) six months later with one line changed.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Diesel owners to the buddy who complains about the pump

first_3_seconds: Night shot of his white lifted OBS at a gas pump; cartoon Monsters Inc characters edited into the cab bouncing around; text above; movie line "Get out of the car, please" lands at 4 s
spoken_or_text_hook: Text: "When the homie and I are filling up and he starts messing with my 30 year old truck..."

who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Old truck owners to the friend who slams the door or plays with the switches
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: One static shot of your truck, text naming a thing a passenger does that makes you nervous, and a known audio line as the punchline.

first_3_seconds: Black frame with white title text and a letterboxed 2 Fast 2 Furious phone call scene (the "you want to race tonight" call); original movie dialogue playing
spoken_or_text_hook: Text: "If Brian O'Connor Drove A 7.3 Powerstroke (Accurate Edition)"; audio: "Yeah, man, you want a race tonight?"
why_it_went_viral: Movie recut with his OBS dropped in: glow plug wait, slow trip, then it loses power and misses the race. Self-roast of the 7.3 that owners agree with, plus 50 s of story, gave 4.7% shares at 27x median. "Accurate Edition" answers the comments on the earlier version, which pulls those people back.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: 7.3 owners to each other and to the Cummins buddy who calls it slow; Fast and Furious fans
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Take a famous scene everybody knows and retell it with your truck's real flaws as the plot, told by you to camera or with your own truck shots as the cutaways.

first_3_seconds: Dark night scene, generated or CG: a white OBS drives up a huge curved ramp, launches off the top, then lands on rocket smoke; no on-screen text, the joke lives in the caption
spoken_or_text_hook: Caption: "7.3 owners will literally learn to fly before buying a new truck"
why_it_went_viral: Absurd visual that holds the eye for 13 s, tied to a true identity line (7.3 guys never upgrade). 27x median, 3.14% shares. The "X owners will literally do Y before Z" sentence is the portable part.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: 7.3 owners to each other; wives and buddies to the guy who will not sell his old truck
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: One line in the form "[truck] owners will literally [absurd thing] before [sensible thing]" over a clip of you doing the absurd fix.

first_3_seconds: Door of the white OBS opens, he climbs in (legs and arm only, no face), then a close shot of his hand turning the key; red script text mid-screen
spoken_or_text_hook: Text: "1997 7.3L Coldstart"
why_it_went_viral: Pure sound and ritual: key turn, exhaust tip close up, engine settling. 24x median but 0.36% shares, so it was watched and liked, not sent. Reach from sound-on replays in winter, nothing to pass to a friend.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Barely shared; 7.3 fans save or like it
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Three shots, no talking: get in, key turn, exhaust tip. Good filler for reach, weak for sends.

first_3_seconds: Drone orbit of the white OBS hooked to a fifth-wheel camper with a pontoon boat double-towed behind it in an empty lot; question text up, answer text pops in at 2 s
spoken_or_text_hook: Text: "How much can a 7.3L tow?" then "All of it."
why_it_went_viral: Asks the question strangers always ask and answers in three words with a picture that proves it. 23x median, 3.06% shares, and the double tow starts a legal or not fight in the comments.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Truck guys to the buddy who says old trucks cannot work; campers and boat owners
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Put the question you get asked most on screen in quotes, answer it in three words, and let one wide shot of the truck doing it be the proof.

first_3_seconds: Black frame with a movie-poster title and a Tokyo Drift street scene where his white OBS is edited in place of Han's car with Han leaning on it; song from the film playing
spoken_or_text_hook: Text: "F7.3 Not Fast, Very Furious"
why_it_went_viral: 7 second single-image joke: a title pun that roasts his own truck for being slow. 16x median, 3.64% shares. Short enough to loop twice, and the pun is the thing people forward.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: 7.3 owners to each other; Fast and Furious fans to truck friends
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: A movie-title pun about your truck's best-known weakness over one still or slow push-in of the truck.

first_3_seconds: Same black frame and 2 Fast 2 Furious phone call scene as bensdiesels-05, original dialogue; later his OBS with blue underglow leaves the garage and this time makes the race
spoken_or_text_hook: Text: "When 7.3 owners add a KC Turbo and Hydra"; audio: "Yeah, man, you want to race tonight?"
why_it_went_viral: Highest share rate of his ten (8.18%) at 14x median. Names two parts that every 7.3 owner either has or wants, so it flatters the guys who bought them and tags the brands; the movie scene carries the watch time.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: 7.3 owners to the buddy who just did a turbo and tuner, and to the one still stock
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Name the two mods your crowd argues about and show the before and after attitude of the owner, played by you alone in the cab.

spoken_or_text_hook: Caption: "Your boyfriends dream truck"
why_it_went_viral: 36x median with only 1.13% shares: a slow 31 s walkaround of a very clean truck, inside and out, with a caption that pokes girlfriends. It is truck porn that got watched through, and the caption gave people a reason to tag someone.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Girlfriends to boyfriends (caption bait); OBS fans to each other
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Slow continuous walkaround, tail to cab to interior, one caption line that tells a specific person to send it to another.

shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Put a real question you get about a choice on your truck on screen, answer it in two words, and show the thing.

shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Golden-hour walkaround with the lights on, close on wheel, badge, grille, no talking.

who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Few; mostly argued over in comments

why_it_went_viral: A trending joke audio where the reveal (opening the door on a trashed cab) lands right on the punchline. 10x median, 0.74% shares. The timing of door-open to the last line is the whole trick. The joke is at women's expense, so it is not one to copy as written.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Truck guys to buddies
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Voice sets up a comparison on the outside of the truck, the door opens on the punchline. Keep the roast aimed at yourself or the truck.
